This game is really great. Almost everything is really good and the few drawbacks are minimal.

Pros :
- Good amount of cars
- Lots of customization
- Greats controls both on wheel and controller
- Cars and most tracks based on real life
- Tracks are quite big with "hidden" areas that can be explored
- Grinding money is easy and fast

Cons :
- Not a lot of tracks
- Becomes quite repetitive at some point
- Grinding money at the beginning can be slow
- Car suspension can sometimes feel very bumpy
- Maybe I didn't find it but can't easily change between tunes for a car

Overall the game is…
